dedupe_keys.name: reseau de transport urbain ca vichy communaute 2025

description: Réseau de transport urbain - CA Vichy Communauté - 2025 is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Service SIG (Vichy Communauté). Mobivie urban transport lines and stops. Coverage: Service SIG (Vichy Communauté). The portal shows the English title as "Urban transport network - CA Vichy Community - 2025" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Service SIG (Vichy Communauté). Its keywords include reseaux-de-transport, arrets, lignes, donnees-ouvertes, open-data, ca-vichy-communaute. The listing shows 4 download or service links in 0-HTTP--LINK, OGC:WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
